commit.subject: feat(steme): add steme doctrine --check validating every guide and skill reference
commit.body:
Split the shared rulepack loader into readActiveRulepacks +
rejectDuplicateRuleIds with loadActiveRulepacks composing them in the
unchanged order (its suite passes unmodified). Add DoctrineModule.check:
from any path in a workspace, resolve the active policy and report every
missing stackpack guide and rule skill at once — exit 0 when all resolve,
1 when any is broken, 2 when it cannot run. Register --check on the
doctrine command (exactly one of --for/--check), add human and JSON
renders, regenerate the usage spec and CLI docs. The query's eager guide
check is untouched in this commit.

phases.title: Loader split, doctrine check capability, CLI `--check`

commit.subject: feat(steme): doctrine --for resolves only the guides it surfaces
commit.body:
A doctrine query now existence-checks only the root guide and the guides
bound to its matched scope and concepts. An unsurfaced declared guide
whose file is missing no longer refuses unrelated queries; a surfaced one
still refuses at exit 2 naming the key. The every-reference guarantee the
query gives up lives in steme doctrine --check (previous commit). e2e case
(9) rewritten into surfaced/unsurfaced proofs; audit untouched.

phases.title: Lazy guide resolution in the query
